title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Blueberry Cherry Cranberry Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Blueberry Cherry Cranberry Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod brings three berries together in a layered fruit mix. Sweet Blueberry blends with the richness of Cherry and the tart edge of Cranberry for a flavour that’s juicy, tangy, and satisfying. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically replenishes the pod as you vape. Together they deliver up to 20,000 puffs depending on use, with no coil changes or messy refilling needed. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod provides consistent vapour production and clear flavour from start to finish. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re set to go.
